headline: Nvidia's $750B deal surge raises circular financing concerns in AI infrastructure
body: Nvidia announced $750 billion in deals while launching its Open Secure AI Alliance and forming a strategic partnership with Ilya Sutskever's new AI lab, but the moves have reignited concerns about circular financing in the AI sector. For healthcare AI vendors and health systems, this signals potential volatility in the GPU and compute infrastructure market that underpins clinical AI deployments. The concentration of compute resources and financing around a single vendor creates dependency risks for organizations building AI workflows into EHR systems or value-based care programs. Healthcare AI consultants should evaluate long-term vendor strategy around compute access, pricing sustainability, and alternative infrastructure partnerships when advising clients on large-scale clinical AI implementations.
